title: MineNight
description: MineNight is a growing Minecraft network featuring competitive BoxPvP modes, and a active community. Join us and start fighting!
body:
**Welcome to MineNight Network 🌙**

MineNight is a Minecraft network built from the ground up with one goal is delivering a competitive experience.
What we offer
- 🥊 Dedicated BoxPvP modes
- ⚔️ Competitive gameplay
- 🎮 Active community
  
Whether you're a seasoned PvP player or just starting out, MineNight has something for you.
Join us and become part of the best Community.
